description: Codex-reviewed European candidates from the 2026-10-21 Europe granularity research (UK, Czechia, Slovakia, Poland) and granularity pilot (southern/eastern France; Moscow Reichskommissariat RKM in TNO), plus the remaining Ukraine candidates from the 2026-10-21 dense-country research, excluding UA_Kherson whose parent mixes Crimean source IDs. Groups have at most three members sharing a positive-length boundary; protected IDs are national/owner/historical-front borders, major-city hosts and detected river boundaries.
